items.title: Ran Blake interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 16, 2021
items.q: he felt he was the Tchaikovsky captain of the east coast

ctx.x: Yeah. Would you have something in your mind before you got to the piano?

Yes. It wouldn’t be this. It would be more like this [plays piano] and on and on it would go. And it would be very disturbing and I can see people breaking in and here everybody’s mentioned the very decent police that tried to protect the people inside the buildings. And one had a heart attack, and innocent people got hurt. So yes, I would, and I think if I played this every day there would be a cluster of notes that would appear. I might revert to [plays piano] my opening of “Memphis” thinking of the crowd and…
I’d like to veer off for a moment, along those lines, do you have a feeling about current events and what it says about our country and human nature?
